item.title: How can I manage living with MS fatigue?
item.description: People with MS often find it hard to explain fatigue to others, so in this episode we ask how you would describe life with fatigue and what tips you would give for managing it. Plus, occupational therapist, Kate Hayward, shares some fatigue management techniques.

item.title: Meet the MS Trust... MS Trust information team
item.description: Volunteer Will returns with another peek behind the scenes. In this episode Will chats to the MS Trust information team about the questions they get asked, and the work they do to ensure everyone with MS can access the treatments and services they need.

item.title: What is Multiple Sclerosis?
item.description: MS is a condition affecting the central nervous system. In this episode, Simon from our information team gives a MS 101 lesson, covering topics such as how MS is diagnosed, who gets MS, and much more. We also chat to Hugh Nibloe, a Wheelchair Curling Paralympian who lives with MS.

item.title: What is it like taking part in clinical trials for MS research?
item.description: Multiple sclerosis is an active area of scientific research. In our latest episode we learn about developing new MS treatments with Dr Nick Cunniffe, a researcher in Cambridge. We also chat to Faisal about what it's like to take part in a clinical trial.

item.title: Working life and MS
item.description: Most people with MS receive their diagnosis during their working life. This episode covers what working life is like when you have multiple sclerosis. We discuss what rights people have at work, what to do when you feel like you have to give up work or reduce your hours, and much more.

item.title: Talking advance care planning
item.description: Today we are talking about the often misunderstood topic of advance care planning. The MS Trust recently published an information book titled ‘Thinking ahead: setting out your wishes for your future care and treatment’.

item.title: Heat sensitivity and MS
item.description: We catch up with Dr Nikos Evangelou about how and why heat affects people with MS. We also share some of your thoughts and real life experiences of heat sensitivity as well as tips on how to deal with it.

item.title: Relationships and MS
item.description: Sometimes MS can feel like a barrier to our relationships, making it harder to maintain the ones that matter or develop new ones. In this episode we talk about these issues with Billy from Shift.ms, who lives with MS himself, and Flora from our helpline.

item.title: What are disease modifying drugs in MS?
item.description: In this episode Kate, a neurologist, explains the ins and outs of disease modifying drugs (DMD) and how to go about choosing one. We also talk to Sam, who shares her personal journey of choosing DMDs.

item.title: Bringing MS to work: conversations, challenges, and vocational rehab
item.description: Are you wondering how to stay productive while managing MS? Perhaps you are looking for ways to disclose your diagnosis without derailing your career? Then join us and our guests, MS researcher Dr. Blanca de Dios Pérez, Amy and Sam from the charity 'MS Together' and Jane who is recently diagnosed with MS as we delve into the topic of MS at work.
